title: Ultradian Rhythm Planner
description: Schedule your day around 90-minute ultradian focus cycles: wake and bed times become timed deep-work blocks with real breaks.
howto: Enter your wake-up time and bedtime.
Choose focus block length (90 min classic) and break length.
Press Plan to lay out focus blocks across your waking hours.
Work with full intensity during blocks, truly disconnect during breaks.

faqs.a: A ~90-minute cycle of high-to-low alertness the brain runs through the day. Aligning deep work to these cycles — 90 minutes on, 20 minutes off — matches how focus naturally rises and falls.

faqs.q: Why not just work all day?
faqs.a: Focus degrades without breaks; the 20-minute rest lets the cycle reset so the next block starts sharp. The last partial block is shortened rather than crammed.
Yes — some people prefer 50/10 or 120/30. The planner lays out whatever cycle you choose across your waking hours.
